options: Compressing data to save disk space
Copying data to a backup site
questions.explanation: 'Data Deduplication is about removing duplication in the data', and it is mostly involved in the ETL or ELT process.

questions.stem: In which process is Data Deduplication mostly involved?
questions.explanation: Data Deduplication is mostly involved in the ETL or ELT process.

questions.stem: What are the two kinds of data that can be duplicated?
options: Raw or Processed Data, and Absence of Golden Record
questions.explanation: The two kinds are 1) Raw or Processed Data and 2) Absence of Golden Record.

questions.stem: Which is given as an example of duplicate data entered from a badly designed front-end application?
options: A customer wrongly created twice, or a product sold once but entered more than once
A policy with three different codes across systems
questions.explanation: A badly designed system allows a customer to be created twice or a single sale to be entered multiple times through human error.

questions.stem: Which process must remove duplicates created during ETL/ELT transformation into a Data Warehouse or Data Mart?
questions.explanation: Duplicates created either at data entry or during ETL/ELT transformation must be removed as part of the Data Quality process.

questions.stem: What does 'Absence of Golden Record' mean?
options: A table has no primary key
There is more than one code for a single entity across systems
An audit log has been deleted
questions.explanation: Absence of Golden Records means there is more than one code for a single entity, such as the same policy type coded 001, 002 and 003 in three systems.

questions.stem: In the insurance example from I Am Datapedia!, what happens when the marketing department plans campaigns without a Golden Record?
options: One campaign is sent for the one policy type
Campaigns are sent only to new customers
Three campaigns are designed for the same single type of policy
questions.explanation: Because the same policy type carries three codes, marketing ends up designing three campaigns instead of one for the same policy type.

questions.stem: Which application helps create a de-duplicated Golden Record?
questions.explanation: The Golden Record scenario is handled by a de-duplicated Golden Record with the help of a Master Data Management (MDM) application.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the named reasons for duplicated Raw or Processed data?
options: Data entered from front-end applications that allow duplicate entry
Data transformed during ETL/ELT from source systems to the warehouse
A system so badly designed that it allows a customer to be created twice
Human error such as entering a sale twice
questions.explanation: The two main reasons are duplicate entry from badly designed front-ends and duplication introduced during ETL/ELT; disk encryption is unrelated.

questions.stem: Where does data from the three insurance systems flow to in the Golden Record example?
options: A centralised location such as a Data Warehouse or Data Mart
questions.explanation: Data from the three systems flows into a centralised location, a Data Warehouse or Data Mart, where the three policy codes appear as separate policies.
